objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has modified the ownership and access control settings to ensure it has unrestricted write access to target file paths prior to encryption.  [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has leveraged the `takeown`, `icacls` and `attrib` commands to modify permissions on files and folders.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
